items.headline: Cybersecurity stocks rally as investors focus on AI safety
items.summary: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks were among cybersecurity stocks rising while broader US indexes weakened as Treasury yields reached a 19-year high; the report linked investor interest to the firms' potential role in AI safety.

items.headline: AI stocks support Nasdaq rally, but investors seek evidence of sustained infrastructure returns
items.summary: Bloomberg reported that technology-focused US ETFs attracted $22 billion during the quarter versus $4.6 billion for the rest of the market, while hedge funds increased net-long Nasdaq 100 futures exposure; the report said investors still need evidence that AI infrastructure spending will translate into durable returns.

items.headline: Nasdaq reaches record close as Micron and AI-linked shares rally
items.summary: The Business Times reported that Micron Technology and other AI-related stocks helped lift the Nasdaq to a record close on September 22, while oil traded near $100 per barrel and investors awaited developments around the Trump-Xi meeting.

items.headline: AI rally faces a pause as yields and geopolitical risks pressure technology shares
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reported that futures pointed lower after two record Nasdaq closes, with the recent AI-led rally stumbling as chip stocks weakened; Meta's planned AI-product updates were identified as a market focus.

items.headline: Technology-focused ETFs attract substantially more capital than the rest of the market
items.summary: Bloomberg reported that technology-focused US ETFs received $22 billion in quarterly inflows compared with $4.6 billion for the rest of the market, highlighting continued concentration in the AI and technology trade.
